messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v3.4.7 -> 10% across eu-west/eu-central. warming 2 pods per AZ. changelist: release-notes/3.4.7.md :rocket:
jen-sre: seeing an uptick in tail latency on a subset of requests in eu-west-1 (p95 ~ 420ms). not huge but correlated with increased CPU on infer-gpu-43.
alex-eng: thanks — can you paste the query that spikes it? also which model shard is this hitting?
sam-ops: @alex-eng I pushed a small routing tweak 20m ago (edge fallback tweak). could be related.
jen-sre: snippet from svc logs: ```2026-03-23T09:12:15Z ERROR kvcache miss hotloop: model=v2-quant shards=[3,4] latency=421ms```
maria-relman: Release notes updated with the known p95 blip. notifying PG. change window still OK (low traffic).
carol-pm: Is this a rollback? We have a marketing banner scheduled in 30m. Need a clear go/no-go in 10.
alex-eng: quick check — rolling back the routing tweak would be noisy. can we throttle the rollout to 3% and observe?
sam-ops: deploy-bot supports throttling. `deploybot adjust --percent 3 --target canary` — I can run now if folks agree.
jen-sre: +1 for throttling. current evidence not strong enough for full rollback. prefer freeze at 3% and run a focused telemetry sweep for 15m.
maria-relman: Agree. I'll pause the banner and update comms.
carol-pm: ok holding marketing, thanks. @alex-eng can you check model shard KV cache metrics and KPS during the freeze?
alex-eng: on it. pulling kv hit ratio and GPU utilization. will report in 7m.
kb-ci-bot: CI alert: nightly perf-run completed; v3.4.7 passes baseline acceptance.
jen-sre: ops: please also add a short-term circuit to route traffic off infer-gpu-43 if p95 > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes. prefer automated fallback rather than manual rollback.
sam-ops: adding a temp route rule now. `rb add route --host infer-gpu-43 --drain-threshold 500ms`
jen-sre: noted. if fallback triggers, we will pin to v3.4.6 in the pinned regions and escalate.
maria-relman: consensus: THROTTLE -> HOLD at 3% pending 15m of telemetry. do not rollback yet. marketing paused.
carol-pm: please post a quick runbook in #incidents if behavior degrades.
alex-eng: kv hit ratio dropped 8% on the affected shard, GPU mem pressure rose ~12%. could be cache warmup issue with quant variant. investigating quant load path.
jen-sre: thanks. if you see mem blowouts, call rollback. otherwise keep pinned hold and we'll revisit at 15m.
deploy-bot: rollout adjusted to 3% (requested by sam-ops). next check-in at 15:22 UTC.
maria-relman: added note to release-playbook: "hold at 3% for eu, pause marketing, observe p95 and kv-hit"
carol-pm: final: HOLD at 3% — no rollback. will reconvene on thread in 15. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
